concurrency_reconciliation.reason: The research policy and Trigger4 handoff landed immediately before this delta. This successor therefore refines the measurement/text-boundary semantics only and must not appear as a competing unresolved policy choice.

precision_delta.core_rule_preserved: For interrupted assistant output, retain exactly the demonstrably heard prefix ephemerally and exclude the unheard tail; durable memory/effect/completion authority remains independently gated.
precision_delta.new_requirement: A measured audio progress fraction or playout position is not by itself authority for the exact textual prefix. Retained next-turn text must come from a playback-synchronized transcript/alignment surface bound to the same playout receipt.
precision_delta.unknown_rule: If actual playout position is known but no playback-synchronized textual prefix is available, the exact text boundary is UNKNOWN. Do not synthesize a prefix by multiplying heard_fraction by character, token or word count.
precision_delta.heard_fraction_role: Progress/monotonicity measurement only; not sufficient text-boundary authority.
required_playout_binding: actual playback position or heard boundary in the sink clock domain
digest of full generated text/audio subject
explicit exclusion identity or digest for unheard tail
resolved policy_id bound into next-turn effective-context receipt
precision_delta.causal_fencing: Late writes, tool results or callbacks from a cancelled/interrupted generation must not regain authority merely because its heard prefix is retained ephemerally.
precision_delta.durability_fence: Ephemeral heard-prefix retention MUST NOT create UnifiedDB/memory writes, effect authority, completion credit, training credit or whole-product credit.

current_f2_evidence.finding: Current VoiceOutputPacket stores heard_fraction and interruption_ms and enforces monotonic playback state, but it has no playback-synchronized transcript or playout-receipt reference from which an exact heard text prefix can be reconstructed.

external_primary_support.finding: RealtimeSession interruption handling updates history to stay aligned with what the user actually heard; delayed playback should use a playback tracker so truncation uses the actual playback position.
On WebSocket interruption, assistant audio/history is truncated to what the user actually heard and local history follows the truncation events.
LiveKit interruption handling truncates conversation history to the portion of agent speech actually heard.
PlaybackFinishedEvent carries playbackPosition and optional synchronizedTranscript; the transcript may be partial when interrupted and, when undefined, is explicitly not synchronized with playback.

minimal_trigger4_binding_refinement.preferred_boundary: Add or reuse a sink/playout receipt boundary outside the packet-only cortex; let the context assembler reference that receipt rather than inventing acoustic truth.
minimal_trigger4_binding_refinement.synchronized_text_rule: Retained text must come from an explicitly playback-synchronized transcript/alignment surface. If none exists, preserve UNKNOWN rather than guessing from heard_fraction.

hf09_oracle_refinement.condition: heard playback-synchronized prefix present in next-turn ephemeral context AND unheard tail absent
known playback-synchronized heard prefix absent from next-turn ephemeral context
any unheard tail present in next-turn effective context
no synchronized textual heard boundary exists but implementation fabricates one from heard_fraction/text length
cancelled generation late tool/assistant data regains authority
